conditions: One Windows BelowNormal run under the shared heavy lock, Node 24.21.0; synthetic reduced smoke only. Shared-host scheduling and GC are uncontrolled.

commandCosts.scope: CPU only; excludes durable IO, retention, HTTP, calculator, GC control and concurrency. applyValidatedCommand is the existing store.command boundary.

projection.assumption: Only durable write count scales (31 -> 1301), keeping reduced save byte size and Windows per-group rates. Excludes nonlinear registry/file-count/retention costs and catalogue/setup scaling. Full-size runtime is unmeasured.
